name: God Life
source: The year is 2027, you play as an Asgardian war refugee, father of 6 beautiful girls, your wife has gone and you live with your family in your own island in greece. Wishing never to go back to your home planet and despite being so different you are trying to live a normal human life, hiding from the world who you truly are. You have a successful business and you only work when you want to. Always spending your days relaxing in your tropical paradise, but things start to change a bit when your daughter the last remaining to awaken powers has just started to change.
translation: 2027年，你将扮演一位来自阿斯加德的战争难民，六个美丽女孩的父亲。妻子已经离去，你与家人住在希腊属于自己的小岛上。你希望永远不再回到母星，尽管与人类如此不同，仍努力隐藏真实身份，过上普通的人类生活。你经营着成功的生意，只在自己想工作时才工作，平日总在热带乐园中悠闲度日。然而，当女儿中最后一个尚未觉醒力量的孩子，开始发生变化时，生活也渐渐有了转变。
